== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Tatooine: Bluffs (Japanese)|Tatooine: Bluffs]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/tcg/company-sets/1997-decipher-star-wars-ccg-new-hope-limited-japanese/imagegallery/587873 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/156625018/Wu_COXkIr0yZosocjN178A.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 89673874.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>a22565396dd4c4494aa1985e90359447c712859400a75add0541fb3c9b5e8225</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
